advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a negative fsck test: a channel-less compiled_state with NO retained `.retired` CREATE must NOT emit SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL (pins the _has_retired_create guard).
evidence: Gate: `isinstance(_compiled, dict) and "creation_channel" not in _compiled and _has_retired_create(ticket_dir)` (fsck.py:313-317)

The only fsck detection test (test_rollback_recovery_detects_and_repairs_stale_channel_snapshot, tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_creation_channel_compaction.py:156) asserts SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL is present when a compacted legacy ticket retains its CREATE — the positive path only.

ABSENCE: no test creates a snapshot whose compiled_state lacks creation_channel but has no `*-CREATE.json.retired` and asserts `_check_snapshot` returns NO SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL finding; the _has_retired_create false-positive guard is regression-blind.
advisory.finding: The SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL detection gate depends on _has_retired_create() to avoid flagging a channel-less snapshot that has NO retained CREATE (not rebuildable), but only the all-conditions-true positive path is tested; the negative branch (compiled_state lacks creation_channel AND no retained .retired CREATE => must NOT flag) is never exercised, so inverting or dropping that guard would produce spurious rebuildable findings undetected.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test that writes a SNAPSHOT-only ticket dir (compiled_state without creation_channel, no *-CREATE.json.retired file) and asserts `not any("SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL" in f for f in fsck._check_snapshot(...))`.
